fields.text: Video said to show fire at Halyard plant; company says no fire reported.

A video circulating online that appears to show a fire at the Halyard Components plant was not filmed at the plant, a company spokesperson said. The spokesperson said no fire was reported on Tuesday. Lakeshore Fire Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Lakeshore Fire Department said it received no fire calls from the Halyard plant on Tuesday. A metadata check by Meridian Wire found the video was uploaded in 2022.
fields.editorsNote: Updates the 5:58 PM ET bulletin with the fire department statement.
